name: @map-harness/stream-providers
description: Real stream source access for the realtime workbench: the versioned `stream-providers@1` contract binding two real source families (a standard SSE endpoint and an OpenAI-compatible streaming completions relay), by-name cc-switch credential resolution, bounded read rounds with parked in-flight reads, and deterministic multi-source fusion behind one fused event-time horizon. A pure library the service face consumes — no host row.
